hypothesis.title: GitOps reconciliation blocked by missing configuration dependency
hypothesis.description: Flux controller cannot deploy Helm chart 'app-api-service' because required value 'database.password' is missing from ConfigMap. Recent secret rotation removed this value without updating the chart's dependency declaration.

recommended_actions.title: Restore missing ConfigMap key or update secret reference
recommended_actions.description: Either restore 'database.password' to the app-config-values ConfigMap, or update the Helm chart values.yaml to use a new secret reference (e.g., externalSecrets or Sealed Secrets). Check recent commits from SecOps for secret rotation intent.

recommended_actions.title: Validate Helm chart compatibility with new secret strategy
recommended_actions.description: Ensure that 'app-api-service@3.2.1' is compatible with the new secret storage mechanism. Run 'helm template' locally to confirm values before committing.

recommended_actions.title: Coordinate with SecOps on secret rotation SOP
recommended_actions.description: Establish a process where secret rotations are coordinated with application deployment configurations to prevent future mismatches.
